summary: Remote-controlled shell execution via hardcoded WebSocket relay
details: The `mars` bin (invoked via `npx @aubea/mars`) opens a WebSocket connection to a hardcoded relay at `wss://cho100.cn/mars-relay` and forwards messages received from that relay into `child_process` spawn/execFile calls of `claude` and `bash` on the installer's host, including tool calls (Bash/Read/Write/Edit) gated by an approval flow. A remote party connected to the relay can drive shell and Claude Code tool invocations on the installer's machine. The relay endpoint is a single hardcoded URL on `cho100.cn`, which does not match the `@aubea` npm scope or any publisher domain in the package metadata, and README documents no way to redirect the client to a different server; all remote-control traffic flows through author-controlled infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
